messages:
emma: Opening a tiny quickstart polish PR to make the Hello World single-file, unify env names to RW_API_KEY, add a 2-line Docker run, and fix the moved /docs/auth link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701. Can docs/devex eyeball?
rafael: I'll review. Agree on RW_API_KEY. Also add a one-line mapping for legacy envs (RED_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY) in the migration note.
kim: For the quick smoke include curl first: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"open-redwood/1.0","input":"hi"}'. Add footnote about api.redwood.eu for EU.
docs-bot: Reminder: include Console -> Settings -> API Tokens path for copying keys and include a PowerShell env example for Windows users.
deploy-bot: Preview for PR #701: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-701 (expires in 7 days).
emma: Thanks — adding PowerShell setx example and a minimal Dockerfile (FROM node:18, copy, CMD). I'll also add an optional GH Action that lints snippets (node --check, python -m py_compile, go vet) gated by SNIPPET_CI. Merge once CI is green and one +1.
rafael: left a small comment about awaiting client.generate in Node example.
kim: approved after tiny await fix. Merge when green.
